Your account

Using this device

Account settings include intervals, clock format, available hours, hidden hours, tags, personality, and reminder switches. Allow notifications and activate reminder audio separately on each device.

Your layout & personality

Choose the look and voice for your day. Headers, daily quotes, and Focus Mode follow your choice.

Layout design

Your choice is saved on this device.

Your timeline

Give your day as much structure as you like.

Changing intervals keeps every note. Notes in the same interval appear together.

Your available hours

Choose your usual available hours for each day. Share availability starts with these hours, and you can edit them there for any share.

An end time of 00:00 means midnight at the end of the day. Hours use this device’s time zone and must end after they start.

Hide intervals entirely before your available hours.

Hide intervals starting at or after your available hours end.

Intervals that overlap a boundary stay visible. Hiding times keeps all notes and reminders; use Show full day in Daily to see everything.

A gentle nudge

For intervals with an unfinished note.

A soft chime when it’s time.

Keep Dayline open for reminders. Closed-app alerts aren’t supported in this version. Device settings may silence sound.

A CHANGE OF PLANS

Reschedule note

Choose any day and an exact time. Other notes stay where they are.

Restore this backup?

This replaces all notes and settings on this device. Download your current backup first if you want to keep it.

Bring your notes along?

This adds this device’s notes to the account you’re signed into. Existing account notes and the original device notes are kept.
